source.title: Ballymena Observer, 9 May 1930, p. 10 ("Ballymena Rural Council nominations: contests in Ahoghill and Portglenone")
source.publisher: Ballymena Observer (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: sole nomination; 'only in two will there be contests—Ahoghill and Portglenone' (Ballymena Observer, 9 May 1930, p. 10, image-read), and only Portglenone was polled (Ballymena Observer, 23 May 1930, p. 9)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, one for each of the 23 divisions, polled on Thursday 5 June 1930 in Portglenone only. Nominations were received on 7 May 1930 (Ballymena Observer, 9 May 1930, p. 10): twenty divisions had one nominee each, Ahoghill and Portglenone two, and Tullaghgarley none, its sitting member, Samuel M'Millen, being deemed re-elected. In Ahoghill the sitting member withdrew and A. C. Logan was declared elected (Ballymena Observer, 23 May 1930, p. 9). No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed.
